description: This file provides functions and data structures related to establishing and probing TLS (SSL) connections specifically for gateway communication, including fingerprint verification, SSL context configuration, and hostname verification.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing TLS parameters such as whether TLS is required, expected fingerprint, whether to allow Trust on First Use (TOFU), and a stable ID.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for establishing TLS connections.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum representing possible failure reasons when probing TLS fingerprint, such as TLS unavailability or endpoint unreachable.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including the fingerprint hash and failure reason if any.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a GatewayTlsConfig object based on provided parameters, setting up trust managers and hostname verification accordingly.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Performs a TLS handshake to probe and retrieve the SHA-256 fingerprint of the peer certificate from a specific host and port.
